blocks.text: AI is a great planner: it turns your tasks and wishes into a clear schedule. You just need to tell it what matters.

items: Goal – what you want (get fit, a stress-free trip, a calmer week).
Time – how many days, hours or minutes you have.
Plan format – by day, a table, a list of steps.

blocks.text: Make me a 4-week walking and exercise plan. I'm 45, I don't train, I work in an office and I have 30 minutes a day. Make each week a bit harder. Give me a table by day.
If you have health problems (heart, blood pressure, injuries), always show the plan to a doctor. AI is not a doctor.
I'm planning 3 days in Rome with two kids (7 and 11) in July. Medium budget. Make a day-by-day plan with 2–3 main things a day, breaks, and ideas for a cheap lunch.
List all your tasks for the week, paste them to the AI and ask for a day-by-day schedule with priorities. When something comes up, just write "I can't do Wednesday, rearrange it".
Claude can turn your plan into a neat document you can copy or save – just ask for it "as a document".
Some versions of ChatGPT can also set reminders or scheduled tasks – check what your app offers.
Gemini can look up current information for your trip (opening hours, ticket prices) – but still check the official website.
